output.reason: [ev-aa02449851f9] says the regression came in v1.16.0, only affected ACME ClusterIssuers, and is fixed in v1.16.1+ and v1.17.0+. So the version range 1.16.0 ≤ version < 1.16.1 is right. However, matching any ClusterIssuer with gvk-in-use is too broad: it would also flag environments whose ClusterIssuers use only non-ACME issuer types. The exposure condition should require a cert-manager.io ClusterIssuer that has spec.acme set ([ev-60054fcf0986] confirms that the cert-manager.io ClusterIssuer API exists in 1.17.0).

correction.statement: Environments upgrading from cert-manager v1.16.0 (before 1.16.1) that have an ACME ClusterIssuer (spec.acme set) are affected: the v1.16.0 regression made these issuers look in the wrong namespace for issuance resources such as credential Secrets, and 1.17.0 fixes the lookup.
